in_marathi.name: Dhruvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Descendant of Dhruva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhruvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dhruvansh is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a combination of the words Dhruva and Ansh. Dhruva is the name of a legendary king in Hindu mythology, and Ansh means 'descendant'. Thus, Dhruvansh means 'descendant of Dhruva'.
